status: UNSELECTED PROJECT REQUIREMENTS; finite endpoint adapter construction implemented, actual metal containment/material/assembly qualification OPEN. No Alpha geometry guarantee.
identity: Existing Alpha Wire 5859 BK005, 19/27 AWG14. No hardware or MPN change.

bulk_current_class.section: The same contained polygon section used by the finite tip trial; centred normal-frame sections, disjoint or with zero normal trial current at touching boundaries.
bulk_current_class.scope: These constrain actual contained strand paths. They do not assume regular hexagonal unilay, equal physical current, an Alpha lay pitch, or infer arithmetic per-strand transfer energy from assembled parallel DCR.

bulk_potential_class.scope: One continuous potential in bundle coordinates, shared across all actual metal including touching strands. Every actual conductive material in the bulk must meet the resistivity floor and section/extent envelope. This is not nineteen independent strand potentials. Both fans/tips/solder may carry their land's constant trial value.
bulk_potential_class.temperature_scope: The 2e-5 floor is the separate uniform nominal 70 C hot-only proposal. Normal/cold calculations instead use the unselected direct 100 MS/m all-metal conductivity ceiling. Neither is a manufacturer guarantee or qualified process.
bulk_potential_class.bundle_axis_condition: Monotone in board-depth z with initial axial tangent; source sin-squared bows satisfy the stated slope and curvature bounds. This establishes the near-end branch used to convert global endpoint extent into bundle arclength.

interface_trial_class.scope: A finite upper bound on normal transfer energy over each of the nineteen supported squares, for both copper-tip/solder and solder/PCB interfaces. Uniform current is an admissible trial, not a claim about actual current density. The four interfaces of a complete wire are booked once inside the existing combined 0.2 mOhm termination budget.
interface_trial_class.qualification: PROJECT REQUIREMENT / NEEDS BENCH #65; no primary manufacturer interface-resistance guarantee is claimed.

endpoint_gate: Constructed sufficient 0.25 mm / <=3 degree adapter class; actual contained tubes, incoming sections/tangents/roll and all-metal extent remain unqualified #65. No physical equipotential wire cut is introduced.
downstream_K: The K board must retain compatible full wetted supports and conductor trial traces. Its finite common/private allocation and the complete joined branch proof remain #43 obligations. Common PCB/K spreading and separately charged wire/termination functionals must be stated before acceptance.

endpoint_adapter_class.status: UNSELECTED conditional factory geometry; not an Alpha endpoint-angle guarantee
endpoint_adapter_class.physical_support: Nineteen actual contained/disjoint normal-frame arc tubes, matching bulk polygons and the finite fan roots. Input centre offsets and section roll must agree with the constructed arcs. No guessed unilay pattern.

normal_material_class.status: UNSELECTED PROJECT REQUIREMENT / NEEDS BENCH #65; not a manufacturer guarantee
normal_material_class.scope: Every actual conductive material in the modeled bulk, including coatings and touching strands, across all permitted normal operating conditions. This directly bounds maximum conductivity; no new minimum temperature or narrow hot-only floor is inferred. The permitted operating envelope and actual applicability must be qualified before selection.
